title: 機械応用プログラミングⅠ
subtitle: Numerical Analysis for Mechanical Engineering I
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) acquire the ability to perform basic numerical analysis using programming. (2) acquire the ability to evaluate the results of numerical analysis. (3) learn branching and repetition under various conditions.
advice: This is a basic course on numerical analysis. We will cover the following topics: 1. Computer literacy 2. Integers and real numbers 3. Input and output 4. Function programming 5. Branching programming (if, if else, else) 6. Repetition programming (for, while, do while) 7. Array programming 8. Pointer functions
